task: The experiment "bulk_discounts_copy test" in Production is set up but not running. Start it.
finalText:
DONE: Experiment "bulk_discounts_copy test" (id 17) in Production (environment 183) is now `running`, with `started_at` 2026-11-27T20:23:25Z. I started it through the experiment's `/start/` action and changed nothing else.

The Production flag `bulk_discounts_copy` still shows variant `b` at 0% weight in `flag get`. The experiment's own rollout config (100% rollout, 50% allocation to variant 37) is stored on the experiment, so I did not alter the flag itself. Please check in the dashboard that the experiment is delivering the variant to the expected audience.
